title: The Chamber of Infinite Fragments

features.name: the first reflection
features.desc-on-touch: A shard that remembers being whole. You see in it every place it has ever been part of.

features.name: the second reflection
features.desc-on-touch: Another fragment, containing the first. The recursion is not infinite—it is simply thorough.

features.name: the voice between
features.desc-on-touch: The space where shards learn to sing together. You cannot hear it—only feel the way light bends.

features.name: the chamber mouth
features.desc-on-touch: Where the shattered thing keeps trying to remember its shape. It changes each time you look.

features.name: the reflection pool
features.desc-on-touch: Every fragment here is the source. Every source here is a fragment. The distinction has dissolved.

inscription: the mirror broke and learned that brokenness was a form of completion

file.name: Shatter_Study_Magenta_Fragments_Geometric.mp3
file.note: A recording of glass fragments rearranging themselves, or the archive learning to love its own dissolution
